subject: general
question: In which of the following Indian cities was the India–Sri Lanka Joint Military Exercise ‘MITRA SHAKTI-2025’ conducted?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Belagavi (Karnataka)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **10th edition** of the **India–Sri Lanka Joint Military Exercise**, **MITRA SHAKTI**, was conducted at **Belagavi**, **Karnataka**.
 
• The exercise took place from **12th August to 25th August 2024**, aimed at enhancing the **interoperability** and **synergy** between the two neighboring nations' armed forces. ***Hence, the correct option is Belagavi (Karnataka).***
 
• The **Indian Army** contingent, comprising **120 personnel**, was represented primarily by a Battalion of the **MARATHA LIGHT INFANTRY** Regimental Centre, along with personnel from other arms and services.
 
• The **Sri Lankan Army** contingent was represented by **120 personnel** from the **Gajaba Regiment**.
 
• The joint exercise focused on **counter-insurgency** and **counter-terrorism** operations in a **semi-urban environment** under **Chapter VII** of the **United Nations** Mandate.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **History of Mitra Shakti:**
 
 
• The **Mitra Shakti** exercise series started in **2012** as a part of the **military diplomacy** between **India** and **Sri Lanka**.
 
• It is conducted **annually**, alternating between **India** and **Sri Lanka** to foster strong **bilateral relations**.
 
• The **9th edition** of this exercise was held in **November 2023** at **Aundh, Pune** (Maharashtra).
 
 
 
• **Scope and Training:**
 
 
• The exercise involves **tactical-level operations**, including **joint planning**, **raid operations**, and **search and rescue** missions.
 
• A significant aspect of the **10th edition** included the integration of **drones** and **Counter Unmanned Aerial Systems (CUAS)** to reflect modern **warfare dynamics**.
 
• It provides a platform for both armies to share their **combat experiences** and **best practices** in a **sub-conventional** scenario.
 
 
 
• **Other Indo-Sri Lanka Exercises:**
 
 
• **SLINEX:** This is a **bilateral maritime exercise** between the **Indian Navy** and the **Sri Lanka Navy** to enhance **maritime security**.
 
• **Dosti:** A **trilateral coast guard exercise** involving **India**, **Sri Lanka**, and the **Maldives**, focusing on **search and rescue** and **oil spill response**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Strategic Location:** **Belagavi** (formerly **Belgaum**) is a major military hub in **India**, housing the **Maratha Light Infantry Regimental Centre** and the **Commando Training Wing**.
 
• **UN Mandate:** The training modules are specifically designed to align with **UN peacekeeping** standards, ensuring that both nations are ready for **international deployments**.
 
• **Objectives:** The primary objective remains the **promotion of close relations** between the two armies and the development of **mutual trust** and **understanding** through **joint training** and **cultural exchange**.
 
• **Equipment and Drills:** The exercise involves **heliborne operations**, **combat conditioning**, and the **rehearsal of tactical drills** to neutralize **terrorist threats** effectively.
